title: Meeting a Partner's Parents
paragraphs: Preparing to meet his fiancée's parents for the first time, Zaki felt genuinely nervous, having heard from her that her father in particular held quite traditional expectations about a future son-in-law.

During the visit, rather than trying to impress them with exaggerated confidence, Zaki asked genuine questions about her family's background, listening carefully rather than dominating the conversation with his own achievements.
Her father later mentioned to his daughter that he appreciated Zaki's genuine curiosity about their family more than any impressive resume detail Zaki could have mentioned during the visit.
Reflecting afterward, Zaki realized that authentic interest in someone's family often mattered more than trying to perform an impressive version of himself during such an important first meeting.
